name: Voxel studio
description: Light-grey studio with a wall of live charts, blocky characters and floating label chips. Data and finance explainers.
rules: Light stage with a chart wall; characters in hats or uniforms (original designs).
Label chips with green outlines float over objects (tags overlay).
Title bar at the top (step-label), caption box at the bottom with a green accent.
Slow camera: long 2-5 s shots; props explain the idea (rings, bars, glass columns).
Keep green for good, red for bad, amber for in-between.
typography: Heavy sans, dark on white boxes.
audio_direction: light upbeat bed, pop on chips, tick on counters
pitfalls: Chart wall too busy behind captions.
